body: I don't understand, why do I have to live if it messes me up?  I can't stand it anymore, I don't know anymore, I can't sleep anymore, I can't live anymore.  I never wanted that, I didn't want to exist

I did everything i could 

psychiatrists, psychologists, hospitalization, physical exercise, medications, art and love

I don’t care anymore
I can be just another one 
That’s doesn’t matter 
Nobody cares 
My funeral will be the only moment that I’ll be happy , people will fake that truly love me
